summary: The Spanish Grand Prix is a significant event in Formula One, held at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. Notable performances include Lewis Hamilton winning the race, Max Verstappen achieving his first victory, and Lella Lombardi being the only woman to score points in a Grand Prix. Vitaly Petrov finished eleventh in the latest edition, while other drivers like Fernando Alonso and Sebastian Vettel have also had notable results.

key_statements.statement: Lewis Hamilton won the Spanish Grand Prix.
Max Verstappen finished in first place at the Spanish Grand Prix.
Lella Lombardi finished sixth in the Spanish Grand Prix, making her the only woman to score points in a Formula One Grand Prix.
Vitaly Petrov finished eleventh at the Spanish Grand Prix.
Fernando Alonso won the Spanish Grand Prix in 2006.
Sebastian Vettel finished in third place at the Spanish Grand Prix.
